title: Incremental information test - does mechanical-forecast GLS-ICC carry return information beyond B/P?
status: DRAFT - not frozen. Freezes after the extended dividend fetch lands.
question: Does firm_icc (GLS-ICC built on R1 mechanical forecasts) predict the cross-section of 36-month forward returns AFTER controlling for book-to-price, size, and momentum? This is the decisive viability test: R0 showed the heuristic V/P adds nothing over B/P; R1 showed mechanical forecasts ~ random walk for large caps; R2-B showed ICC is constructible and sane. R3 asks whether the ICC signal carries incremental information.

sample.rows: R2-B rows with a solved icc_ri (1638 firm-origin rows across origins 2019-2023), restricted to rows with a computable 36-month forward return.
sample.forward_return_window: origin (June 30 of Y) to June 30 of Y+3, using the extended r3 price cache (2019-05-01..2026-08-01) and extended r3 dividend cache (2018-01-01..2026-08-01).

dependent_variable.definition: 36-month annualized TOTAL return tr = ((p1 + div)/p0)^(1/3) - 1, where p0 = last close on/before the origin, p1 = last close on/before origin+36m, div = dividends paid strictly inside (origin, origin+36m]. Matches the R0/X2 return convention.
dependent_variable.excess_note: The cross-sectional regression uses total return; subtracting the per-origin risk-free rate is a per-origin location shift that does not change cross-sectional slopes, so slopes are identical under excess returns. Stated in advance.
dependent_variable.price_basis: Prices are today-basis (split-adjusted); dividends are split-adjusted to the same basis. Consistent.

regressors.bp: book-to-price at origin = B0/price (B0 = R2 book-per-share, today-basis; equivalently book/mcap).
regressors.size: log market cap at origin = log(price * shares_basis).
regressors.momentum: 12-1 momentum = P(origin-1m)/P(origin-12m) - 1. Available only where 12 months of pre-origin prices exist (origins 2020-2023; origin 2019 lacks pre-2019-05 prices). Momentum rows restricted accordingly.

specifications_precommitted: S2: tr ~ BP + ICC (incremental over B/P alone)
S4: tr ~ BP + ICC + size + momentum (balanced panel, origins 2020-2023, momentum-available rows only)

inference_precommitted.fama_macbeth: Per-origin cross-sectional OLS for each spec, then time-series mean of the per-origin coefficients with Newey-West (lag 1) t-stat across the 5 origins. Five origins is a thin time series; the FM t-stat is reported but its weakness is stated.
inference_precommitted.pooled: Pooled OLS across all firm-origin rows with origin fixed effects (dummies), clustered standard errors by origin. This is the higher-power read; reported beside FM.
inference_precommitted.primary_read: The incremental-information verdict rests on the ICC coefficient in S2/S3/S4: sign, and significance under BOTH pooled-origin-FE and FM. A coefficient is 'significant' if |t| >= 2 in the pooled read AND the FM sign agrees; the FM t is reported transparently given only 5 origins.
inference_precommitted.guards: No outlier truncation of the dependent or regressors beyond the input-side plausibility guards already applied in R2 (guards on inputs only, per the R2 agreement). No post-result spec selection - all four specs reported.

verdict_mapping_precommitted.icc_incremental_positive: ICC coefficient positive and significant (per primary_read) in S2 AND S3 (with momentum-robustness S4 agreeing in sign where computable) -> mechanical-forecast ICC carries incremental information over B/P. Feeds the final verdict toward RIM viability on the expected-return lens (supports B).
verdict_mapping_precommitted.icc_incremental_none: ICC coefficient not significant, or significant only without controls / flipping sign under controls -> mechanical-forecast ICC does NOT carry incremental information beyond B/P. Combined with R1 (forecasts ~ RW), this feeds the final verdict toward C (needs PIT analyst forecasts) or D.
verdict_mapping_precommitted.icc_incremental_negative: ICC coefficient significantly negative -> the mechanical ICC signal is actively misleading; feeds toward D.

prohibitions: No post-result spec selection, outlier trimming, or control swapping.
No public number republication; quarantine untouched.
